incident-bot: PAGER: High restart rate detected for pods in namespace=redwood-inference, deployment=inference-autoscaler-2 (eu-west-1). Alert: pod_restarts > 50/min across 3 nodes :rotating_light:

Mira (oncall): ack, I’m on it. Marking priority P1.

Leah (support): getting multiple customer reports about 503s on /v1/generate, customers on eu-west-1 seeing degraded throughput. Escalating in CS.

Ellen (sre): I see a correlated spike in evictions during a scheduled node drain that started ~2m ago. Pods are crashlooping instead of terminating cleanly. Dumping events: 
```
# kubectl -n redwood-inference get events --field-selector involvedObject.name=inference-autoscaler-2 | tail -n 20
Warning  Evicted    2m    kubelet    Pod evicted due to node drain
Normal   Killing    2m    kubelet    Stopping container inference
Warning  BackOff    2m    kubelet    Back-off restarting failed container
```

Mira (oncall): is this limited to the canary subset or all replicas?

Ellen (sre): initial look: only nodes that were cordoned for maintenance show the issue, but HPA reacted and pushed replicas to other nodes and then scaled down to 0 for a short window because minReplicas is 0 in the rollout config. That caused traffic routing chaos.

Ryan (eng): we pushed a deployment earlier with a temporary feature flag to change the readiness probe path to /ready-check-v2. That flag should be off in canary but may have leaked to more replicas. If readiness fails, kubelet kills and then backoff.

Mira (oncall): confirmed in pod spec: readinessProbe.path=/ready-check-v2 on 4/6 pods. HPA minReplicas=0 in the rollout preview config. That's bad.

Ellen (sre): mitigation plan: 1) flip feature flag to roll back readiness change 2) bump HPA minReplicas to 2 in eu-west-1 to prevent scale-to-zero 3) pause node drain to stop new evictions.

Jordan (pm): customer impact? Any high-value customers on those nodes?

Leah (support): two enterprise customers (acme-inc, fastshop) reported increased errors — they have traffic in eu-west-1. CS has informed them we’re investigating and asked for logs.

Mira (oncall): executing mitigations now. First, cancel the drain: 
```
kubectl uncordon ip-10-0-34-22.eu-west-1.internal
kubectl uncordon ip-10-0-36-11.eu-west-1.internal
```

incident-bot: Deploybot run detected: rollout inference-autoscaler-2 @ryan-eng by ryan-eng at 2026-03-15T03:40:12Z (status: in_progress).

Ryan (eng): flipping feature flag kill-switch in LaunchDarkly -> "ready-check-v2" -> set to OFF for eu-west-1 targeting.

Mira (oncall): updating HPA: 
```
kubectl -n redwood-inference patch hpa inference-autoscaler-2 -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":2}}' --type=merge
```

Ellen (sre): I’m scaling deployment to 4 replicas to get healthy pods scheduled on uncordoned nodes while HPA stabilizes: 
```
kubectl -n redwood-inference scale deploy/inference-autoscaler-2 --replicas=4
```

Leah (support): CS pinged acme-inc with ETA ~15m and mitigations. They acknowledged, asking for timeline for a rollback if not resolved.

Mira (oncall): we should pause the rollout to prevent more pods with the bad readiness config from being created. Triggering rollout pause: 
```
kubectl -n redwood-inference rollout pause deployment/inference-autoscaler-2
```

Ryan (eng): paused. Also initiating a canary rollback for that release tag: `docker:image@sha256:bad123` -> `docker:image@sha256:good999` and redeploying to canary subset.

incident-bot: Action logged: rollback started by ryan-eng at 2173456925.

Ellen (sre): within 60s, new pods without the readiness change came up healthy on eu-west-1 nodes. Restart rates dropped to normal. Watch metrics: pod_restarts -> down to baseline, 503s -> trending down.

Mira (oncall): monitoring load balancer error rates and customer 5xxs. No further evictions observed after uncordon. Handoff to eng-oncall in 30m for follow-ups and postmortem.

Jordan (pm): thanks all. Jordan — please coordinate postmortem and communication to affected customers, include timeline and root cause (feature-flag leak + HPA minReplicas=0 + simultaneous node drain).

Leah (support): confirmed CS will send status update in 20m with mitigation details.

Mira (oncall): summary for the postmortem: cause: bad readiness probe toggle leaked to non-canary, combined with rollout config allowing minReplicas=0 and an overlapping node drain. Mitigations done: uncordoned nodes, paused rollout, flipped feature flag, bumped HPA minReplicas, scaled replicas, rolled back bad image.

Ellen (sre): follow-ups: make minReplicas safer in preview configs, add a pre-drain check that validates no in-progress rollout with minReplicas=0, and add a guard in the deploy pipeline to prevent feature-flag exposure outside canary.

Mira (oncall): closing pager, will leave thread open for postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:
